thread:
ania: Starting a thread to propose a coordinated service consolidation effort. Goal: reduce operational churn from many tiny services, centralize stable adapters, and reclaim runway for infra maintenance. Target horizon: 2-3 quarters.
sam: Agree this is overdue. How do we objectively pick candidates without biasing for "easy deletes" only?
mike: We should use measurable heuristics + manual vetting. Also a pilot to validate migration pattern before broad rollouts.
lee: Suggested heuristics (quick draft):
```
- avg QPS < 1 over 30d
- deploy freq <= 1 per 30d
- single owning team
- less than 3 active alerts in last 90d
- not on model-serving hot path
```
ania: Good start. We'll run infra-bot to generate a candidate list by these filters, then manually review each for hidden state or tenant-specific logic.
infra-bot: scan-complete: 42 hits. sample: enrich-legacy-3, sidecar-lite, auth-shim-old, runtime-adapter-a
sam: Can infra-bot attach call graph snippets and which services call them? That helps avoid collateral refactors.
infra-bot: attached: call-graph-matrix.csv, top-callers.json
mike: Migration strategy proposal: three patterns depending on category:
- merge-to-platform: move stateless adapters into platform library and deprecate service
- extract-shared: pull reusable modules into a new shared package, keep thin facade
- archive: shutdown redundant services after draining
lee: For merge-to-platform, require feature-flag + per-tenant rollout for 4 weeks, and a canary with automated rollback.
ania: Pilot plan: 2-week audit, then pilot merging 2 low-risk services (one merge-to-platform, one extract-shared) over 6 weeks with detailed SLIs.
sarah: I'll lead the auth-shim-old extraction. Risk: preserves tenant auth semantics and migrate secrets safely.
mike: Add SLI checklist for pilots: p95 latency, p99 warm-start latency, 5xx rate, request success per-tenant. Also cost delta measurement.
lee: Add tracing tag header for any request passing the consolidated code, e.g., `X-merged-from: service-name` so we can slice metrics.
ania: I'll draft RFC follow-up with candidate spreadsheet, infra-bot outputs, risk classification, and a proposed timeline. Volunteers: @mike @lee @sarah for the spike.
sam: Can we also align this with cost OKR? Even a small percentage reduction in sidecar/adapter overhead helps.
ania: Early calc: consolidating platform adapters and reducing container count likely saves ~10-15% on the small-service pool. Will include an impact calc in the RFC.
mike: Safety nets: automated rollback test in ci (`make rollback-test`), canary policy, and a fallthrough routing rule to preserve traffic in case of failure.
lee: Please ensure feature flags are tenant-scoped and we keep per-tenant fallbacks for 4 weeks.
sarah: For auth extraction, we need a migration plan for secrets — KMS read-only during migration window and audit logs enabled.
infra-bot: scheduled: spike-scan-job on 2025-05-12
ania: OK. I'll post the RFC follow-up tomorrow with audit links, the full candidate list, and the pilot playbook. We'll review in next architecture sync.
sam: Thanks 44f happy to review the RFC.
mike: Count me in for the pilot. 680
ania: Action items captured in RFC: run infra-bot full scan, manual vetting session, pilot merges, pilot dashboards, cost SLO measurements.
